sceneConcept: A broad-shouldered Chinese construction foreman in his late forties stands alone against a transparent background. His sun-tanned face, short black hair, heavy eyebrows and rough stubble show years of outdoor work. He wears an old blue work jumpsuit with rolled sleeves, a completely plain orange safety vest, work gloves tucked at his belt and scuffed work boots. He studies a smartphone held low in one hand with a hesitant frown while the other hand carries an unworn plain yellow hard hat, under soft even frontal studio light without signage or a bright rim. Visual refresh: a dusty high-visibility vest, blue work shirt, helmet and mismatched construction gloves.
